# Changelog

Concise delivered project milestones. Detailed design rationale belongs in `DECISIONS.md`; implementation/evidence detail belongs in ExecPlans and docs.

Record revision: `2026-09-18-i4-parity-closed-v1`.

- **2026-09-18 / I4-R01-BYTE-PARITY** — Corrected pinned frozen-encoder XSim proves exact 80-byte R01 parity for legacy and prebuild accepted orders and zero integrated R01 bytes for a kill-switch reject.
- **2026-09-18 / I4-AMU-CONTRACT-CORRECTION** — First real pinned-AMU/frozen-encoder parity run exposed that successful new INSERT reports found=0; admission, CI stub and lifecycle tests were corrected to the frozen AMU contract and the full exact-head regression stack passed again.
- **2026-09-18 / I4-DUAL-SOURCE-R01-GATE** — Focused R01-boundary regression proves ordinary and prebuild order sources both traverse risk, prebuild retains priority, and kill-switch rejection cannot reach the encoder contract.
- **2026-09-18 / I4-SHARED-CL-EX-OWNER** — Shared-core regression proves one futures-state/AMU owner across CL admission and committed execution, including OPEN-to-fill-to-CLOSE closed loop and execution priority under simultaneous acquisition.
- **2026-09-17 / I3-OOC-POSTROUTE** — Real-AMU I3 atomic CL2EX U50 OOC physically closes at 156.25 MHz: synth WNS +3.023 ns, routed WNS +1.583 ns, TNS 0, 2392 LUT, 2693 FF, 11 RAMB36 + 1 RAMB18, 10 DSP and zero routing errors; later I4 evidence narrows the original real-AMU functional-contract claim.
- **2026-09-17 / I3-HFT-ORDER-GATE** — Frozen-HFT order-gate regression closes exact account/product mapping, Side translation, mapping/policy fail-closed behavior, normalized context correctness and byte-identical accepted payload.
- **2026-09-17 / I3-ROLLBACK-FAIL-CLOSED** — Fault injection proves an admission rollback failure can never accept an order and is escalated to an explicit recovery-required system failure.
- **2026-09-17 / I3-ATOMIC-ADMISSION** — Atomic CL2EX admission regression proves policy/accounting no-mutation, successful reserve+insert, duplicate/full rollback, stable result backpressure and no leaked reservation after recoverable store failure; its AMU INSERT found-bit assumption was later corrected in I4.
